svg.text: The screen of consciousness and its write-back loop
Every module holds a copy of the whole screen. The one granted write access projects its whole
transformed copy back onto the screen — not merely the part it recognised.
(access consciousness: the multimodal field you can report on)
broadcast: a copy of the whole screen, to every module
one module writes at a time
write access: it projects its whole transformed
copy back onto the screen — so each element of
the screen is the whole screen, transformed
